text.formatted: If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.
text.plain: If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.

text.formatted: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.
text.plain: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +8, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.

text.formatted: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. _Failure:_ 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga's next turn. _Success:_ Half damage only.
text.plain: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

text.formatted:
The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** Thaumaturgy
- **1/Day Each:** Clairvoyance, Cure Wounds (level 6 version), Flame Strike (level 6 version), Geas, True Seeing
